concerns.text: FR-006 mandates that the pipeline must *terminate* if total runtime exceeds the 6‑hour limit, but task T012 only records a pass/fail flag without aborting execution, leaving the requirement unfulfilled.
The implementation plan introduces Phase 0.5 to generate IR spectra in‑house using B3LYP, yet tasks.md contains no task that performs this generation step, so the plan element is uncovered.
Phase 5 describes two control experiments (scrambled‑order spectra and pure random‑noise spectra), but tasks.md lacks any tasks that execute, evaluate, or store the results of these experiments.
Tasks are annotated with tags like [US1], [US2], [US3], [US4] and [P] which are not defined anywhere in the specification or plan, resulting in stale tags that do not map to any FR/SC/plan element.
